hub.title: Play
hub.subtitle: Short games for the two of you. No scores and no winner.
hub.noPartnerNote: Games need both of you. When your partner joins, you can play.
hub.refreshNote: To see if anything changed, come back to the app or pull to refresh.

meOrYou.title: Me or you
meOrYou.intro: Answer separately who fits each phrase better. Then see where you thought alike.

howWell.title: How well you know me
howWell.intro: Each of you answers about yourself and guesses the other's answer. Then comes the conversation.

twentyQuestions.title: 20 questions
twentyQuestions.intro: Light questions to answer in private and reveal together.

neverHaveWe.title: Never have we
neverHaveWe.intro: Things you have never done together. Each of you answers in private and you see both sides at the end.

mission.title: Date mission
mission.intro: A date idea to do together and a short reflection afterwards.

start.cancelledNote: The last invitation was cancelled. You can start again whenever you like.
start.expiredNote: The previous invitation expired. Invite again whenever you like.
start.noContentTitle: This game has no questions yet
start.noContentText: There is no content to play yet. Come back soon.

waiting.text: Invitation sent to {name}. It starts when they join.
waiting.textFallback: Invitation sent. It starts when your partner joins.
waiting.window: The invitation waits for up to 48 hours.

active.title: The game has started
active.text: Both of you are in. This game's screens appear here.

playing.talkHint: Write your answer. Only you can read it until you both finish.
playing.talkNote: Your partner only sees this after both of you answer.

date.startNote: Do the mission together, then come back and tell how it was.
date.reflectionText: Pick what happened. Your partner sees it only after you both answer.

waitingPartner.title: You answered everything
waitingPartner.text: Now it is just waiting for {name}. Nothing you wrote appears before both of you finish.
waitingPartner.textFallback: Now it is just waiting for your partner. Nothing you wrote appears before both of you finish.

finished.title: That was a good conversation
finished.text: No score, no winner. Just the two of you.

notFound.title: This game does not exist
notFound.text: It may have changed or never existed. Go back and pick another one.

cancel.title: End the game?
cancel.text: The game ends for both of you. You can start another later.

noPartner.title: Games are for two
noPartner.text: When your partner joins, you can play together.

errors(map).NOT_PAIRED: Games need both of you connected.
errors(map).NOT_FOUND: That game no longer exists. We'll refresh.
errors(map).GAME_ALREADY_OPEN: A game is already open. Finish or cancel it before inviting again.
errors(map).GAME_NOT_COMPLETE: Your partner is still answering. Try again when they finish.
errors(map).other: Could not do that right now. Try again.
